# Demographic

This folder contains topics related to the demographic characteristics of surgical patients within the corpus. Currently, it holds a single page detailing procedural volumes and age distributions for patients operated on in Danmark between September 2022 and August 2023, providing a focused snapshot of median and mean ages without broader subgroup breakdowns.

## Pages

- [[demographic|Demographic]] — Surgical patient statistics for Danmark (2022–2023), including total procedural volumes and age distributions (median and mean).
